### 1.2 Deployment Strategy

| Aspect | Strategy |
|--------|----------|
| **Deployment Type** | Rolling Update |
| **Replica Count** | 3 (production), 1 (dev/staging) |
| **Update Strategy** | maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0 |
| **Health Checks** | Liveness + Readiness probes |
| **Migrations** | Automatic via init container |
| **Rollback** | Automated on health check failure |

[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/deployment.md#31-environment-variables]

### 3.1 Environment Variables

**ConfigMap** (`k8s/configmap.yaml`):

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: rating-service-config
  namespace: eapref-app
data:
  # Application
  SERVICE_NAME: "rating-service"
  SERVICE_VERSION: "1.0.0"
  ENVIRONMENT: "production"
  LOG_LEVEL: "INFO"

  # API Configuration
  API_PREFIX: "/api/rating/v1"
  CORS_ORIGINS: "*"

  # Database
  DATABASE_ECHO: "false"
  DATABASE_POOL_SIZE: "20"
  DATABASE_MAX_OVERFLOW: "10"
  DATABASE_POOL_TIMEOUT: "30"

  # Pagination
  DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE: "50"
  MAX_PAGE_SIZE: "100"

  # Feature Flags
  ENABLE_CACHING: "false"
  ENABLE_METRICS: "true"
```

**Secret** (`k8s/secret.yaml`):

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: rating-service-secret
  namespace: eapref-app
type: Opaque
stringData:
  database-url: "postgresql+asyncpg://rating_app:encrypted_password@postgres-cluster-rw:5432/rating_service"
  # Stored in AWS Secrets Manager, synced by External Secrets Operator
```

[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/deployment.md#41-deployment-manifest]

### 4.1 Deployment Manifest

**File**: `k8s/deployment.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: rating-service
  namespace: eapref-app
  labels:
    app: rating-service
    version: v1
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: rating-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: rating-service
        version: v1
    spec:
      initContainers:
        - name: run-migrations
          image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/rating-service:latest
          command: ["alembic", "upgrade", "head"]
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: rating-service-secret
                  key: database-url
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi

      containers:
        - name: rating-service
          image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/rating-service:latest
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
              protocol: TCP

          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: rating-service-secret
                  key: database-url

          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: rating-service-config

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 1000m
              memory: 2Gi

          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/rating/v1/health
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3

          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/rating/v1/health
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 2

          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
```

page_texts.19:
[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/deployment.md#51-postgresql-cluster-cloudnativepg]

### 5.1 PostgreSQL Cluster (CloudNativePG)

**File**: `k8s/postgres-cluster.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: postgres-cluster
  namespace: eapref-app
spec:
  instances: 3
  primaryUpdateStrategy: unsupervised

  postgresql:
    parameters:
      max_connections: "200"
      shared_buffers: "4GB"
      effective_cache_size: "12GB"
      work_mem: "64MB"
      maintenance_work_mem: "512MB"

  bootstrap:
    initdb:
      database: rating_service
      owner: rating_app
      secret:
        name: postgres-superuser

  storage:
    size: 20Gi
    storageClass: gp3

  backup:
    barmanObjectStore:
      destinationPath: s3://eap-ref-backups/postgres
      wal:
        compression: gzip
      retention: "30d"
    schedule: "0 2 * * *"  # Daily at 2 AM

  monitoring:
    enablePodMonitor: true
```
page_texts.22:
[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/deployment.md#61-automated-deployment-cicd]

### 6.1 Automated Deployment (CI/CD)

**GitHub Actions Workflow** (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`):

```yaml
name: Build and Deploy Rating Service

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/**'

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        id: login-ecr
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

      - name: Build Docker image
        working-directory: .tooling/components/apis/rating-service
        run: |
          docker build -t ${{ steps.login-ecr.outputs.registry }}/rating-service:${{ github.sha }} .
          docker tag ${{ steps.login-ecr.outputs.registry }}/rating-service:${{ github.sha }} \
                     ${{ steps.login-ecr.outputs.registry }}/rating-service:latest

      - name: Push to ECR
        run: |
          docker push ${{ steps.login-ecr.outputs.registry }}/rating-service:${{ github.sha }}
          docker push ${{ steps.login-ecr.outputs.registry }}/rating-service:latest

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig --region us-east-1 --name eap-ref-cluster

      - name: Deploy to Kubernetes
        working-directory: .tooling/components/apis/rating-service/k8s
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f configmap.yaml
          kubectl apply -f secret.yaml
          kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml
          kubectl apply -f service.yaml
          kubectl apply -f ingress.yaml

      - name: Wait for rollout
        run: |
          kubectl rollout status deployment/rating-service -n eapref-app --timeout=5m

      - name: Verify deployment
        run: |
          kubectl get pods -n eapref-app -l app=rating-service
          kubectl get svc -n eapref-app rating-service
```
page_texts.23:
[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/deployment.md#62-manual-deployment]

### 6.2 Manual Deployment

```bash
# 1. Build Docker image locally
cd .tooling/components/apis/rating-service
docker build -t rating-service:local .

# 2. Tag and push to ECR
export ECR_REGISTRY=123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
export IMAGE_TAG=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

docker tag rating-service:local $ECR_REGISTRY/rating-service:$IMAGE_TAG
docker tag rating-service:local $ECR_REGISTRY/rating-service:latest

docker push $ECR_REGISTRY/rating-service:$IMAGE_TAG
docker push $ECR_REGISTRY/rating-service:latest

# 3. Apply Kubernetes manifests
kubectl apply -f k8s/configmap.yaml
kubectl apply -f k8s/secret.yaml
kubectl apply -f k8s/deployment.yaml
kubectl apply -f k8s/service.yaml
kubectl apply -f k8s/ingress.yaml

# 4. Watch rollout
kubectl rollout status deployment/rating-service -n eapref-app

# 5. Verify pods are running
kubectl get pods -n eapref-app -l app=rating-service
```

[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/deployment.md#63-database-migration]

### 6.3 Database Migration

Migrations run automatically via init container, but manual execution:

```bash
# Connect to a running pod
kubectl exec -it -n eapref-app rating-service-<pod-id> -- /bin/sh

# Run migration
poetry run alembic upgrade head

# Check current version
poetry run alembic current

# Rollback to previous version
poetry run alembic downgrade -1
```

### 7.1 Health Checks

```bash
# Check pod status
kubectl get pods -n eapref-app -l app=rating-service

# Expected output:
# NAME                              READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
# rating-service-5d7c8b9f4d-abc12   1/1     Running   0          5m
# rating-service-5d7c8b9f4d-def34   1/1     Running   0          5m
# rating-service-5d7c8b9f4d-ghi56   1/1     Running   0          5m

# Check service
kubectl get svc -n eapref-app rating-service

# Check endpoints
kubectl get endpoints -n eapref-app rating-service

# Health check via pod
kubectl exec -n eapref-app rating-service-<pod-id> -- \
  curl -s http://localhost:80/api/rating/v1/health

# Health check via service
kubectl run curl --image=curlimages/curl -i --rm --restart=Never -- \
  curl -s http://rating-service.eapref-app.svc.cluster.local/api/rating/v1/health
```

page_texts.34:
[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/deployment.md#91-common-issues]

### 9.1 Common Issues

| Issue | Symptoms | Resolution |
|-------|----------|------------|
| **Pods not starting** | `CrashLoopBackOff` | Check logs: `kubectl logs -n eapref-app <pod>` |
| **Init container fails** | Migration errors | Verify DATABASE_URL, check migration logs |
| **503 Service Unavailable** | Health check failing | Check database connectivity |
| **High memory usage** | Pod OOMKilled | Increase memory limits |
| **Slow startup** | Long initialization | migrations taking time, okay if < 60s |
